name: What kind of maintenance is required for a fixed skylight?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for a fixed skylight?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fixed skylights generally require minimal maintenance. Periodic cleaning of the exterior glass to remove dirt and debris will ensure maximum light transmission. It's also important to inspect the flashing and seals around the skylight annually for any signs of wear or potential leaks, especially after severe weather. Addressing minor issues promptly can prevent larger problems. Hometelligent Inc. can advise on best practices for maintaining your skylight's longevity and performance in climates found in Dublin or Pleasanton.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixed skylights need periodic cleaning of the exterior glass and annual inspection of flashing and seals for wear or leaks. Prompt attention to minor issues helps prevent larger problems.
